description: Juno is an AI health assistant designed to support individuals living with chronic illnesses by tracking symptoms, identifying patterns, and preparing reports for healthcare providers.
funding_summary: In 2026, Juno raised a £12 million seed round led by Atomico, with participation from firstminute capital, XYZ Venture Capital, Tenacity Capital, MMC Ventures, and Avenir.
